import datetime,hashlib,json,os,pathlib,subprocess,uuid
p=pathlib.Path('work/resume/connector-transfer-plan-44.json');j=json.loads(p.read_text());start=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat();index=pathlib.Path('/dev/shm/cortex-root-storage-rescue-c5/transfer-45-'+uuid.uuid4().hex+'.index').resolve();e=os.environ.copy();e['GIT_INDEX_FILE']=str(index); objects=pathlib.Path('/dev/shm/cortex-root-storage-rescue-c5/transfer45-objects');objects.mkdir(exist_ok=True);e['GIT_OBJECT_DIRECTORY']=str(objects);e['GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES']='/dev/shm/cortex-root-storage-rescue-c5/transfer44-objects:/dev/shm/cortex-root-storage-rescue-c5/transfer43-objects:/dev/shm/cortex-root-storage-rescue-c5/transfer42-objects:/tmp/cortex-root-storage-rescue/transfer41-objects:/tmp/cortex-root-storage-rescue/transfer40-objects:/tmp/cortex-root-storage-rescue/transfer39-objects:/tmp/cortex-root-storage-rescue/transfer38-objects:/tmp/cortex-root-storage-rescue/transfer37-objects:/tmp/cortex-root-storage-rescue/transfer36-objects:/tmp/cortex-root-storage-rescue/transfer35-objects:/tmp/cortex-root-storage-rescue/transfer34-objects:'+str(pathlib.Path('.git/objects').resolve())
liveindex=pathlib.Path(subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','--git-path','index'],text=True).strip());indexbefore=hashlib.sha256(liveindex.read_bytes()).hexdigest();assert subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()==j['localHead'];subprocess.run(['git','read-tree',j['tree']],env=e,check=True)
seen=set()
for r in j['rows']:
 b=os.readlink(r.get('sourcePath',r['path'])).encode('utf-8') if r['mode']=='120000' else pathlib.Path(r.get('sourcePath',r['path'])).read_bytes();assert hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==r['sha256'];assert '\n' not in r['path'] and '\t' not in r['path']
 if r['blob'] not in seen:
  actual=subprocess.check_output(['git','hash-object','-w','--stdin'],input=b,env=e).decode().strip();assert actual==r['blob'];seen.add(actual)
payload=''.join(r['mode']+' '+r['blob']+'\t'+r['path']+'\n' for r in j['rows']).encode();subprocess.run(['git','update-index','--index-info'],env=e,input=payload,check=True);tree=subprocess.check_output(['git','write-tree'],env=e,text=True).strip();assert subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()==j['localHead']
assert hashlib.sha256(liveindex.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==indexbefore
out={'liveIndexSHA256':indexbefore,'startedAt':start,'endedAt':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'status':'LOCAL_FROZEN_QA_TREE_EXPECTATION','paths':len(j['rows']),'uniqueBlobs':len(seen),'tree':tree,'remoteParentCommit':j['head'],'remoteBaseTree':j['tree'],'localHead':j['localHead'],'commitObjectNotAvailableLocally':True,'liveIndexAndWorkingFilesUnchanged':True,'scratchIndex':str(index),'sourcePlanSHA256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()};pathlib.Path('work/resume/task04-transfer-45-tree-verification.json').open('x').write(json.dumps(out,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps({'status':out['status'],'tree':tree,'paths':len(j['rows']),'localHeadUnchanged':True}))
